Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Eric Ambler is best known as a playwright and that Carol Shields is also best known as a playwright. While both Eric Ambler and Carol Shields had multiple creative roles, Eric Ambler is primarily recognized as an author of spy novels, and Carol Shields is primarily recognized as an author of novels. The Planner failed to identify "author" as their common primary profession and instead mistakenly focused on secondary roles (screenwriter and playwright, respectively). This misinterpretation led to the wrong final answer.
